summary: Request Inbox provides a dedicated endpoint to receive and review incoming HTTP requests. It allows you to set up capture folders and define custom server replies for diagnostic purposes.
goodFor: Developers who need a straightforward, self-hosted webhooks catcher to debug API integrations and inspect raw payload data.
watchOut: The low activity level and sparse community adoption suggest this is an early-stage project that may lack long-term maintenance.
deployNotes: Since it runs via Docker, you will typically need to map a persistent volume for data retention and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
